THIS MFA CROB, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM:
HON'BLE
MR. JUSTICE UMESH M ADIGA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel for the cross-objector Sri C. R. Ravishankar, submits that MFA No.3427/2015 has been disposed of by this Court vide judgment and award dated 27.10.2023.
This Court allowed the said appeal by setting aside the judgment and award and the matter was remanded to Tribunal for reconsideration.
2. He further submits that, in view of the disposal of the main appeal, the present MFA Crob does not survive for consideration, as it was filed seeking enhancement of compensation.
NC: 2026:KHC:527 HC-KAR 3.
The said submission is tenable.
Accordingly, the MFA.Crob is dismissed as having become infructuous, in view of the disposal of MFA No.3427/2015 by this Court.
All rights of the appellant are kept open to be urged before the Tribunal.
Send the copy of this order to Tribunal.

Sd/-
